sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November, looking to maintain their position atop the table. Sandbach's recent form shows a win in their last outing followed by two defeats before that, though they remain clear at the summit with 37 points from 17 games. Stafford Town sit fourth with 32 points and come into the match having won their most recent fixture, so this promises to be a competitive encounter between two strong sides.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals, unbeaten in their last six league games, face an interesting double-header—first hosting Dawley Town on Saturday before travelling to face New Mills on Tuesday evening. Second-place Casuals are in exceptional form and looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, occupying third place, travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday in what should be a straightforward fixture given their respective league positions. Eccleshall, fifth in the table, host Barnton, who sit seventh and have won three consecutive league games; this looks to be a competitive mid-table clash. Allscott Heath play Crewe at home on Saturday before facing a Widnes Town side away on Tuesday—both challenging opponents for a team in mid-table. Brereton Social host struggling Alsager Town on Saturday in what should be an opportunity for a home win. Telford Town entertain Widnes Town at home on Saturday, while Wednesfield Community face Shawbury United on Saturday and then travel to Barnton on Tuesday. Foley Meir face New Mills on Saturday, and Shawbury United's midweek assignment sees them host Wednesfield Community. All twelve fixtures across the two rounds take place as scheduled, with the Saturday round all kicking off at 15:00 and the Tuesday midweek fixtures at 19:45.
